teaser.en: Its trunk bristles with long thorns, which is why farmers plant it as a living fence that also bears sweet fruit.
teaser.sw: Shina lake limejaa miiba mirefu, na ndiyo sababu wakulima huupanda kama uzio hai unaozaa pia matunda matamu.

summary.en: *Mnyondoya* is the governor's plum, a thorny shrub or small tree of the coastal bush with sweet dark red fruits. It feeds passers-by, guards farms as a live fence and is used in medicine.
summary.sw: *Mnyondoya* ni mgovigovi, kichaka chenye miiba au mti mdogo wa vichaka vya pwani wenye matunda matamu mekundu iliyokolea. Huwalisha wapita njia, hulinda mashamba kama uzio hai na hutumika katika dawa.

about.en:
*Mnyondoya* is a spiny shrub or small tree. Long, straight spines grow out of the trunk and older branches, a handy way to recognise it. The leaves are oval with toothed edges.

The fruits are round berries, about the size of a cherry, that ripen from red to a deep red-purple, almost black. They are sweet when fully ripe.
about.sw:
*Mnyondoya* ni kichaka chenye miiba au mti mdogo. Miiba mirefu iliyonyooka huchipuka kutoka kwenye shina na matawi ya zamani, njia rahisi ya kuutambua. Majani ni ya umbo la yai yenye kingo zenye meno.

Matunda ni beri za mviringo, kwa ukubwa wa cheri hivi, zinazoiva kutoka nyekundu hadi nyekundu-zambarau iliyokolea, karibu nyeusi. Huwa tamu zikiiva kabisa.

where.en: Look for it in the bushland and thickets of the coastal plain, and along farm boundaries where it has been planted as a hedge.
where.sw: Utafute katika vichaka na vichaka vizito vya uwanda wa pwani, na kando ya mipaka ya mashamba ambako umepandwa kama ua.

uses.en:
The ripe fruit is eaten fresh as a wild snack. The straight stems are cut for poles and tool handles, and because of its thorns the shrub makes a good live fence around farms and homesteads.

It is also used in medicine: the Digo of Diani boil the roots as a remedy for malaria.
uses.sw:
Tunda lililoiva huliwa bichi kama kitafunio cha porini. Mashina yaliyonyooka hukatwa kwa ajili ya nguzo na mipini ya zana, na kwa sababu ya miiba yake kichaka hiki hufanya uzio hai mzuri kuzunguka mashamba na makazi.

Pia hutumika katika dawa: Wadigo wa Diani huchemsha mizizi yake kama dawa ya malaria.

names.en: The Digo name is *mnyondoya*, also written *mnyondoiya* in Mgombato. Swahili calls it *mgovigovi* or *mchongoma*. Among other Mijikenda, Giriama say *mdungatundu* and Duruma *madungatundu*. In English it is governor's plum or Indian plum.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mnyondoya*, pia huandikwa *mnyondoiya* katika Mgombato. Kiswahili huuita *mgovigovi* au *mchongoma*. Miongoni mwa Wamijikenda wengine, Wagiriama husema *mdungatundu* na Waduruma *madungatundu*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *governor's plum* au *Indian plum*.
